# TARA

> TARA is an educational ecosystem for coexistence and a culture of peace
> that brings together training, school structures and a conversational
> component based on artificial intelligence.

At this stage, TARA works with school professionals: teachers, tutors,
guidance, coexistence and leadership teams. It is preparing a pilot in
schools for 2027 (Partner Schools Network).

TARA does not diagnose, does not assess people, does not decide sanctions
and does not replace guidance staff, specialist services or the school's
protection procedures.
